scope: same fixed transport model and frozen inputs; independent audit of recorded selection, timing and provenance, not experimental validation or a global-optimality certificate

diagnostics.audit_pass: Passed means the audit found no evidence inconsistency after all 27 processes terminated. It does not mean every experiment succeeded; inspect observed_status_counts.
diagnostics.coverage: Unique vectors, centered and scaled by fixed 0.2 m bounds; rank tolerance 1e-12. Low observed rank is not an audit failure.
diagnostics.score_counts: Fresh score requests include geometry rejections. Returned deposition is not a precise count of thermal-solver entry. Eligibility combines geometry and physics checks.
diagnostics.censoring: Missing/process-failed arms have no fabricated checkpoints. Recorded worker failures retain independently reconstructable earlier outcomes.
diagnostics.finite_panel: Exact expected uniform best is conditional on a fixed coarse-eligible outcome table, with k=floor(N/4) requests without replacement and baseline fallback. It assumes no independence of physical predictions and is not an equal-wall-time or global-space claim.
